_comment: v1.11.4 - subsection markers for the Latin of the nine new excerpts. The translations were written with their markers already in place and mark_sections.js skips a field that carries them. Boundaries from Perseus (CTS phi0448.phi001), word-exact. Every excerpt in this batch is a whole chapter, so there is no `range` and no `sectionFiles` anywhere, and no citation names its subsections.

(De Bello Gallico V.7).author: gaius-julius-caesar
(De Bello Gallico V.7)._override: Perseus opens section 3 `quod Carus ventus`, the Latin Library `quod Corus ventus` - both are real spellings of the north-west wind, so the anchor is respelled rather than the text emended.
